method.training_graph: Torch CPU FP32 batch forward, eight blocks of2048 rows per seed
method.sampling: CDF draws from frozen parent ScaledRegretSampler(stratum-scaled-feature-conditional), same fixed diagnostic IDs as original probe
method.policy: Normalize positive legal scores; if their sum is zero, uniform over legal actions

limitations: Replay training-distribution diagnostics; not held-out poker strength.
Policies use the Torch fitting graph, not the NumPy deployment implementation; numerical sign differences near zero are possible.
Observed drift and fallback changes do not establish the cause of opponent-specific performance changes.
